_comment: Curated set of well-known, high-impact Linux privesc CVEs, matched by exact version comparison. Intentionally a curated list rather than an exhaustive scrape - extend as needed. 'branch_fixes' handle CVEs backported at different points on different stable kernel branches (e.g. Dirty Pipe). IMPORTANT: fixed-version numbers for the less common/older CVEs below are best-effort from public writeups and may be off by a point release on some branches - every match here is reported as LIKELY (never CONFIRMED) specifically because of this uncertainty; always cross-check against your distro's own security advisory before relying on one.

kernel.name: Dirty Pipe
kernel.description: Arbitrary write to read-only files via pipe buffer flag mishandling.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to 5.16.11 / 5.15.25 / 5.10.102 or later (whichever matches your branch).

kernel.name: Dirty COW
kernel.description: Race condition in the copy-on-write mechanism of the memory subsystem.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to 4.8.3 or later, or confirm distro backport.

kernel.name: OverlayFS privilege escalation
kernel.description: Missing permission check in the OverlayFS module allows capability escalation.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to 5.11.0 or later, or confirm distro backport.

kernel.name: OverlayFS ownership/capability confusion
kernel.description: Improper ownership check when copying a capable file into an OverlayFS mount allows a capability-inheriting SUID-root binary to be created.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to the fixed point release for your branch (see distro advisory).

kernel.name: Netfilter heap out-of-bounds write
kernel.description: Heap out-of-bounds write in netfilter's x_tables allows a memory corruption primitive leading to privilege escalation.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to the fixed point release for your branch.

kernel.name: PTRACE_TRACEME credential mishandling
kernel.description: A process that calls PTRACE_TRACEME can gain the privileges of a root parent process that later ptrace-attaches to it.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to 5.1.17 or later, or confirm distro backport.

kernel.name: io_uring out-of-bounds physical page access
kernel.description: io_uring mishandles a registered buffer, allowing out-of-bounds physical memory read/write.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to 6.3.3 or later, or confirm distro backport.

kernel.name: nf_tables (netfilter) use-after-free
kernel.description: Use-after-free in nf_tables allowing arbitrary read/write and privilege escalation; widely weaponized with public exploits since early 2024.
kernel.remediation: Upgrade kernel to the fixed point release for your branch - treat as high priority given public exploit availability.

sudo.name: Sudo Baron Samedit
sudo.description: Heap-based buffer overflow in sudo's command-line argument parsing.
sudo.remediation: Upgrade sudo to 1.8.31p3 (1.8.x branch) or 1.9.5p2 (1.9.x branch) or later.

sudo.name: Sudo user ID -1 / 4294967295 bypass
sudo.description: Runas restriction bypass allowing command execution as root even when explicitly disallowed.

sudo.name: sudoedit privilege escalation via EDITOR/VISUAL
sudo.description: sudoedit (sudo -e) mishandles extra arguments injected via the EDITOR/VISUAL/SUDO_EDITOR environment variables, allowing arbitrary file edits as root.

polkit.name: PwnKit
polkit.description: Out-of-bounds memory access in pkexec allows local privilege escalation via crafted argv/envp.
polkit.remediation: Upgrade policykit-1/polkit to a patched build; check your distro's advisory for the backported fix version.

polkit.name: polkit D-Bus authentication bypass
polkit.description: A race condition in polkit's D-Bus request handling lets an unprivileged process obtain an authenticated session by disconnecting mid-request, bypassing authentication for privileged actions.
polkit.remediation: Upgrade polkit to 0.119 or later, or confirm distro backport.
